title: Keralam’s 24×7 specialty care rollout falters amid political pushback

Officials say the plan hinges on creating hundreds of new specialist posts, a request the Finance department has yet to approve.

title: Here are the big stories from Karnataka today
content: Welcome to the Karnataka Today newsletter, your guide from The Hindu on the major news stories to follow today. Curated and written by Nalme Nachiyar.

title: It is for Parliament to enact law against legislators who resign and re-contest in resultant bypolls: Madras HC
content: Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan say, even the Election Commission has no power to impose a disqualification for five years or demand bypoll expenditure from the resigned legislators

title: IIT-B student suicide: Sahil Wakode’s parents begin hunger strike in Mumbai
content: Parents of Sahil Wakode, an IIT Bombay student who died by suicide, have started a hunger strike. They demand justice and action against those who allegedly tormented their son. The police have opened an investigation into his death, including examination of CCTV footage from the exam hall. Sahil faced allegations of caste discrimination during his studies at IIT Bombay.

title: Nokia closes China research hub, recalls asking Europe why it uses Huawei
content: Nokia is shutting its Hangzhou radio R&D centre in China by end-2026, cutting around 1,600 jobs, after its Greater China revenue fell over 58% since 2018. The closure revives CEO Justin Hotard's pointed question to Europe: why does Huawei still run nearly 60% of Germany's 5G sites while Nokia holds under 3% share in China? Restructuring charges have tripled to €800 million, even as AI and cloud orders surge 105%.

title: PF wage ceiling rises to Rs 25,000: Top FAQs answered for employees
content: For employees, however, the immediate reaction may be simple: What does this mean for me? The answer depends on an employee’s wage structure, provident fund membership status and pension coverage.

title: From 33 to 12 hours, 14 to 6: Vande Bharat, roads cutting travel time drastically
content: Across bridges, tunnels, expressways and railways, projects are replacing long detours, difficult terrain and slower routes with more direct connections.

title: Just 1.85%, yet NSE has best debut among India's five biggest IPOs
content: NSE made its debut as a listed company on the BSE, opening at ₹1,800 and closing at ₹1,818. The initial public offering was valued at ₹22,561.57 crore, making it the second-largest in Indian history. NSE's shares gained 1.85% on the first day despite a broader market decline. The company's IPO was subscribed 5.71 times.

title: Straitcraft: How geography gives Iran leverage and could do the same for India
content: Since the onset of the US-Iran war over 200 days ago, Iran has been strategically utilizing maritime chokepoints such as Hormuz. This has resulted in a marked decline in oil flows, affecting the global economy and forcing the US to reconsider its stance. Concurrently, India is exploring ways to capitalize on its geographical advantages against China.

title: £2,090 painting proved to be lost Helen McNicoll work, sold for £174,000
content: David Taylor made an astonishing find at a UK auction when he acquired an oil painting incorrectly attributed to Helen McNicoll for just £2,090. After expert examination, it was confirmed to be McNicoll's masterpiece, The Bean Harvest, appraised at £300,000. Canadian collector Pierre Lassonde later purchased the artwork for £174,000, ensuring its return to public viewing after a century, highlighting the often-hidden treasures lurking in regional auction houses.

title: Wisconsin campus closed after 60 years; 76-acre site could become 670 homes
content: The Waukesha County Board has approved the sale of the former University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee at Waukesha campus. This property, covering 76 acres, is to be redeveloped into a residential neighbourhood. The plan includes offering approximately 670 homes, consisting of single-family and multifamily units. Local officials estimate the project will significantly enhance the local tax base and generate additional revenue.

title: YouTube CEO Neal Mohan says ‘no’ to joining Meta’s $18 billion child safety deal
content: Neal Mohan has chosen not to participate in Meta's multistate child safety settlement due to existing measures on YouTube. Despite pressures, Mohan highlighted YouTube’s long-standing investments in child safety features and third-party expert collaborations. Meta's settlement includes calls for uniformity in protections for teenagers across platforms, with limitations on usage time and age verification. Ongoing legal challenges are also faced by YouTube and Meta concerning youth harm claims.

title: Auto driver earns Rs 75,000 a month, spends Rs 1.4 lakh on daughter’s education
content: An auto driver shares his monthly earnings of ₹75,000 and annual education expenses of ₹1.4 lakh for his daughter. He struggles to manage everyday costs and has no savings, often borrowing money to meet expenses. The video highlights the difficult balance between education costs and financial stability working families face today. Viewers praised his commitment to prioritizing education against financial limitations.

title: Your evidence may be on CCTV. The problem is getting it in time
content: Individuals seeking CCTV footage for evidence face significant challenges due to legal restrictions and time limitations. The Allahabad high court ruling further complicates access to footage through RTI requests. It emphasizes the importance of timely preservation requests to prevent data loss from overwriting systems. Lawyers suggest pursuing quick preservation mechanisms to safeguard critical evidence effectively.

title: Tom Brady’s parenting stance: Why is his view on failure sparking debate?
content: Tom Brady has sparked a debate over modern parenting, arguing that shielding children from failure could hold them back. The seven-time Super Bowl champion believes kids need challenges to build resilience and confidence. Drawing from his NFL journey and his parents' support, Brady says he wants his three children to learn from adversity rather than take the easy way out.

title: Lauren Kyle on business growth: Why is letting go so hard for her?
content: Connor McDavid’s wife Lauren Kyle has opened up about her ventures and how it has been difficult for her, ahead of the new season.

title: Delhi cop traced 76 missing children across 4 states, earned historic promotion
content: Amid the challenges posed by the Covid-19 pandemic in 2020, Head Constable Seema Dhaka distinguished herself by successfully tracing 76 missing children throughout India. Her commitment emerged as part of a new incentive initiative by the Delhi Police, focused on child recovery. Working under tough circumstances, her exceptional contributions earned her a well-deserved promotion, while the families of the recovered children celebrated their joyous reunions with profound appreciation.

title: 'Today, a Khan and a Singh won a medal for India': Satnam on Asian Games bronze
content: Satnam Singh and Salman Khan won India's first-ever Asian Games medal in men's double sculls on Thursday, with the Indian pair claiming bronze at the Nagaragawa International Regatta Course. But for Satnam, the medal meant much more than a place on the podium. The pair clocked 6:13.25 to finish third.

title: The Backstory: When EC disagreements went public, from Seshan to Lavasa
content: The Election Commission is facing fresh scrutiny after an Indian Express report highlighted disagreements among its members over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise. The dispute recalls two earlier episodes of internal dissent: TN Seshan’s legal battle over the multi-member poll panel in the 1990s and Ashok Lavasa’s dissent during the 2019 Lok Sabha elections. Both cases shaped debates over the EC’s functioning and authority.

title: When umpires disagree: 10 questions at the heart of the Election Commission row
content: The Election Commission is facing questions over reported disagreements between two election commissioners and the CEC on electoral-roll management, decision-making and access to voter data. The controversy has also revived broader concerns over how dissent is handled within the poll panel, the role of the CEC, the appointment of election commissioners and safeguards for voters during large-scale roll revisions.

title: Delhi HC denies anticipatory bail to YouTuber Ajeet Bharti in casteist remarks case
content: Delhi High Court rejected Ajeet Bharti's request for anticipatory bail in a caste-related case. The court determined that a prima facie case was established under the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes Act. Bharti's remarks were deemed derogatory and part of a public social media discussion. His lawyer argued against the applicability of the SC/ST Act based on provocation.

title: Surinder Koli’s post-mortem report is out: Police confirm suicide, rule out murder
content: Surender Koli was confirmed to have died from ante-mortem hanging according to the post-mortem examination. Police investigated Koli's death and reviewed CCTV footage for any suspicious activity. Family and acquaintances were questioned as part of the investigation into the circumstances surrounding his death. Koli previously spent nearly two decades in jail due to the Nithari killings case before his acquittal.

title: 10.09 national record, but a difficult season: Gurindervir's 100m test begins at Asiad
content: Gurindervir Singh begins his Asian Games 100m campaign with a priority: “the medal is the most important thing”. After 10.39s runs at the Commonwealth Games and Bhubaneswar, followed by 10.32s in Delhi, the national record holder enters Aichi-Nagoya with a 10.09s best. With Animesh Kujur and Asia’s leading sprinters in the field, Gurindervir is also hoping the Asian Games can produce the sub-10 run. He has worked hard all year.

title: From rented room to Padma Shri: How Anand Kumar built Super 30 for IIT aspirants
content: Anand Kumar launched the Ramanujan School of Mathematics in 1992 with the vision of providing quality education for talented individuals, especially those from marginalized communities. Drawing from his own economic hardships, he initiated the Super 30 program to support deserving students in their quest for higher education without financial constraints. His commitment to educational equity earned him the Padma Shri award in 2023, showcasing his impact on disadvantaged learners.

title: Sensex ends over 1,200 points down, Nifty below 23,100: Why markets fell today
content: The stock market came under heavy selling pressure, with the Sensex and Nifty declining nearly 1.5% as a sharp rise in bond yields to 19-year highs added to investor concerns.

title: TMC MP Mahua Moitra files police complaint against CEC over SIR row
content: TMC MP Mahua Moitra has filed a police complaint against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, alleging manipulation of voter rolls. Moitra raised specific concerns over unauthorized amendments to Form 6 related to voter registration. Her allegations came a day after a report stated that Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had raised objections at least 14 times over 10 months to decisions and orders related to the SIR.

title: ‘Tried to pull me into SUV’: DU student alleges eve-teasing by group in Delhi
content: Delhi Police received a complaint from a woman about eve-teasing near Hakikat Park at 9.30 pm. During the investigation, police traced the vehicle involved in the incident to its owner. Naman was identified as the driver, accompanied by two to three others during the event. An FIR has been registered under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.

title: In a first, British unmanned sub launches US heavyweight torpedo; why it matters
content: In a groundbreaking test, the Royal Navy's XV Excalibur successfully deployed a US-made Mk 48 heavyweight torpedo at the British Underwater Test and Evaluation Centre in Scotland. This innovative trial showcased the smooth integration of American technology with British autonomous vessels. Such advancements promise to revolutionize naval missions, enhancing the safety of crewed submarines through the use of advanced armed unmanned underwater vehicles.

title: George Floyd’s siblings seek accounting of $14.7m memorial GoFundMe
content: After George Floyd's untimely death in 2020, a fundraising campaign on GoFundMe amassed millions to support his family. However, his siblings are now pressing for a comprehensive audit of the funds raised, alleging an inequitable distribution of the contributions. They have called on Philonise Floyd to produce various financial records linked to the campaign. This unfolding situation emphasizes the critical importance of accountability in the handling of considerable charitable donations.

title: Delhi's parks, streets, shops: Nowhere feels safe for these girls
content: Four cases of sexual assaults against minor girls in Delhi have raised significant safety concerns for the city. The incidents involved girls aged six to 17 years old in various public spaces and shops. Some suspects were quickly arrested, demonstrating police effectiveness in response. However, this highlights the ongoing vulnerability of children in seemingly secure environments. Addressing these risks before crimes occur remains a critical issue for Delhi's safety measures.

title: Passenger forced to take another bus; officials told to pay Rs 60k
content: The Perambalur district consumer commission has mandated Tamil Nadu State Transport Corporation to pay compensation. This ruling followed a complaint alleging improper treatment of a passenger during travel. The passenger had his ticket destroyed and was subsequently removed from the bus without proper verification of his claims. The commission highlighted a lack of inquiry into the incident by the corporation authorities.

title: NEET PG 2026 result declared: How to download scorecard, check key details
content: The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) has announced the NEET PG 2026 results. Candidates can now access their results and rank details through the official NBEMS website. The examination was conducted on August 30, followed by a re-examination at two Jaipur centres. Candidates should download and preserve their result for counselling.

title: BJP announces 24 state-level appointments ahead of crucial assembly polls
content:
state general secretaries and state joint secretaries appointed

NEW DELHI: The BJP on Thursday announced the appointment of state general secretaries and joint general secretaries across several states, naming 24 party leaders for the organisational posts. The appointments come months ahead of crucial assembly elections in five states, as the ruling party continues to strengthen its organisational machinery ahead of the polls. The list includes leaders such as Satish Dhond, V Satish, Manas Mohanty and Mantri Srinivasulu, among others. The announcement comes a day after the BJP named its state incharges for different states. Party leader Smriti Irani has been given charge of Chhattisgarh and Haryana as part of the latest organisational changes. The appointments are part of the BJP's wider organisational exercise ahead of the upcoming electoral battles.

title: White House bars Politico reporter again despite judge's access order
content:
Despite judge’s order, White House again blocks Politico reporter

The White House on Thursday denied access to reporters from Politico and MS NOW, despite a judge ordering the Donald Trump administration to “immediately restore” access for news organisations whose journalists had been barred from the presidential complex. The Politico and MS NOW reporters were denied entry to the White House after their press credentials were confiscated, the outlets reported. The latest move came hours after US district judge Timothy Kelly issued a temporary restraining order early Thursday directing the administration to restore access for Politico, CNN and MS NOW for at least two weeks while further litigation plays out. Reporters from the three organisations had been restricted from entering the White House and had their press passes seized on Saturday. Despite the court order, the White House again barred reporters from Politico and MS NOW from entering the complex on Thursday.

End of Article

title: FSSAI proposes to ban 'paneer' label for substitutes, ensure strict disclosure
content: the proposed amendment would restrict the use of the term "paneer" for analogue paneer and cheese products . it would aim to prevent consumers from being misled about the nature and composition of the food they buy . the proposal would affect food business operators, including hotels, restaurants and catering services .

title: US launches online portal to report visa fraud, misuse; tips can be submitted anonymously
content: the new reporting system covers several categories, including tourist and business visas, employment visas and student visas . it also allows reports involving other forms of suspected immigration or visa fraud . details may include a person's name, passport or visa number, a-Number, petition or receipt number, date of birth .
